title: The OA table promotion batch nine (census 938)

banner.title: The OA table promotion batch nine - 139 table grids from the R614-R773 specs promoted into the 94 OA Lua records - the tables leave the C++ pins
banner.provenance: The OA table promotion - the promotions doctrine continued (the R968 format, continuing the R981-R988 OA set): the promotion is meant for rules AND tables, to alleviate the burden off the C++ pin code, and to place in Lua what originally got placed into C++ code files. The OA monster defs are already in Lua (the 47 registry defs including the 39 Chapter 12 promotions), but the eight R981-R988 promotion batches predate the table promotion - all 160 records shipped tables = {} while the R614-R773 specs declare 139 table grids (the dragon, DSG and WSG promotions carried theirs). This round mechanically re-promotes the tables from the specs into the 94 records that carry them (fix the record from the spec - the promotion doctrine; never hand-edit): 298072 Lua bytes, every record parse-back equal against its spec model, key for key in the spec order, the encoding the R968 record format. The C++ pin headers stay the firewall and the print-fidelity record; the Lua record now carries the table data so the C++ burden can retire. THE TABLE CENSUS: 139 of 139 promoted, 0 remaining - the OA tables gap closed in one round.
